lines.text: Rock-a-bye baby on the tree top, when the wind blows the cradle will rock!
But in deep winter dens, why do bears and sleepy animals nap for months on end?
In freezing winter, berries disappear and bugs hide, leaving very little food!
Instead of hunting in the snow, animals enter a superpower state called Hibernation!
A bear's heart slows down from fifty beats a minute to just eight beats!
Their body cools down and their engine runs in ultra power-saving mode!
They survive all winter by slowly burning energy stored in their autumn fat layer!
When warm spring sunshine returns, they wake up refreshed and ready to play!
Wake up to daily learning and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
